memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI's 30-minute timeout because the build starts with a cold cargo registry cache (~18 min overhead) every time, leaving too little margin for the rest of the build/test work; this recurred on 2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-29.

The permanent fix for atlas's recurring CI cancellations is to add persistent caching for the cargo registry (and ideally target/) between release build runs, keyed on Cargo.lock, rather than raising the 30-minute timeout.
